valuation.title: Canva wipes $11 billion from its valuation, putting IPO plans in doubt

pages.https://www.startupdaily.net/advice/busi: Aug 17, 2026. Canva wipes $11 billion from its valuation, putting IPO plans in doubt. Blackbird and Airtree have revalued their Canva holdings, marking it down 17% to US$34.9B (c. A$49B). Private-share broker Hiive was offering Canva stock on the secondary market at an implied valuation of about US$30bn. Canva's own employee share plan had an independent valuation lopping off around 20%, to US$31bn (A$43.5bn), down from US$38.9bn a year ago. Revenue in the June quarter still grew by 25.2% on 12 months ago to hit US$921.9m (A$1.32bn).
pages.https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/18/canva-: Canva gets to $4B in revenue as LLM referral traffic rises. February 18, 2026. Canva said strong growth helped push its annual recurring revenue to $4 billion by the end of year. The subscription-based company also saw its B2B business grow by 100% with $500 million in ARR. Canva was last valued at $42 billion in a share sell.
